svg.text: ESP32 module with Ethernet (default WT32-ETH01), one WS2812B chain of 58 LEDs, 4 pressure sensors (FSR). Pins: tile_firmware/include/config.h
24 V DC in (from the central PSU)
+5 V – GND at the LED input
+5 V to the LEDs, 1.0 mm² + GND alongside: into the ring at its start (#0) and its end (#47)
Pressed = the reading rises above its resting value (measured at power-up:
nobody on the tile then) by SENSOR_PRESS (600) – released below 350.
Shielded 2-core or twisted pair to each FSR; keep away from the LED 5 V.
IO0 → GND while EN is pulsed = boot mode
LEDs: 58 × 60 mA = 3.5 A at full white; BRIGHTNESS 160 → ≤ 2.2 A ⇒ 5 V / 5 A buck
ESP32 + Ethernet: ~250 mA. One tile ≈ 12 W max; 13 tiles + reserve ⇒ 24 V / 10 A (240 W) PSU
Why 24 V: 5 V over 10 m of cable loses volts; 24 V to each tile, 5 V made at the tile
Level shifter: WS2812B at 5 V wants ≥ 3.5 V data; 3.3 V often works, not always
Other modules: Olimex ESP32-POE (ETH addr 0, power 12, clock GPIO17 out: config.h) – PoE
802.3af gives only ~13 W: lower BRIGHTNESS to ≤ 100 or keep the 24 V feed for the LEDs
A bare ESP32 DevKit: same pins, wifi instead of Ethernet (pio env esp32dev-wifi)
